title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer




Location: Grand Prairie, TX

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Work Environment: Fully On-Site




About the Company

This well-established manufacturer specializes in the production of precision components for wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and electrical control panels for OEMs. With more than 30 years of experience, the company has built a strong reputation for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction across a wide range of industries.

Their capabilities support sectors such as Critical Power, Industrial Automation, Oil & Gas, Medical, HVAC, Food & Beverage, Aviation, and Defense. Through a commitment to operational excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement, the organization has positioned itself as a trusted manufacturing partner and industry leader.




The Opportunity

We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to join the Quality team. This individual will play an important role in supporting quality initiatives across all manufacturing operations, helping ensure product reliability, regulatory compliance, and overall customer satisfaction.

The Quality Assurance Engineer will assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining quality management systems while working closely with engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams to identify opportunities for quality improvement and process optimization.

This position reports directly to the VP of Quality and supports the broader Quality Department.




Key Responsibilities

Quality Systems & Compliance

 * Develop and implement quality control procedures to ensure compliance with internal quality standards and industry regulations
 * Help establish quality assurance standards based on customer requirements and industry expectations
 * Support implementation and maintenance of Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Auditing & Inspections

 * Conduct internal audits and inspections to ensure compliance with established quality standards
 * Prepare audit documentation and reports related to quality assurance activities
 * Support regulatory and certification audits including ISO-related requirements

Documentation & Process Control

 * Work closely with the document controller to edit, maintain, and track documentation within SharePoint
 * Ensure quality documentation, procedures, and records are properly maintained and controlled

Root Cause Analysis & CAPA

 * Investigate customer complaints and internal non-conformance issues in collaboration with Operations and the NPI (New Product Introduction) team
 * Perform root cause analysis and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
 * Support implementation of PFMEA and Control Plans to strengthen manufacturing processes

Data Analysis & Reporting

 * Assist in preparing reports and performance metrics related to quality assurance and compliance activities
 * Analyze quality data and trends to identify improvement opportunities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 * Collaborate with engineering, operations, and production teams to improve quality and manufacturing efficiency
 * Assist in developing training materials for quality assurance and compliance staff
 * Support continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations

Project Coordination

 * Manage multiple quality-related initiatives simultaneously and support cross-functional improvement projects




Qualifications

 * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related technical field
 * 2–4 years of experience working as a Quality Assurance Specialist, Quality Engineer, or similar role in a manufacturing environment
 * Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, standards, and best practices
 * Experience conducting audits and preparing audit reports
 * Familiarity with Quality Management Systems (QMS) and regulatory quality standards
 * Internal auditor certification in ISO 9001, AS9100, or ISO 13485 preferred
 * Strong working knowledge of SharePoint for documentation management
 * Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA implementation, PFMEA, and Control Plans
 * Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret quality data and statistical methods
 * Strong attention to detail and a results-driven mindset
 * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate across departments
 * Reliable, trustworthy, and able to work effectively in a team-oriented environment
 * Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities




Why You’ll Love It Here

 * Established manufacturer with 30+ years of industry experience
 * Opportunity to influence product quality and operational excellence
 * Exposure to diverse industries and complex manufacturing environments
 * Strong collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, and leadership teams
 * Culture focused on quality, innovation, and continuous improvement
 * Competitive salary and benefits package
 * Health insurance, retirement plans, and additional benefits
 * Opportunities for overtime

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

Senior QA Engineer

We’re hiring a Senior QA Engineer who blends strong automation skills with structured manual testing. This role owns quality for their product team, builds reliable automated test suites, and helps shape our testing standards as we scale. You’ll work across engineering, product, and DevOps to ensure every release ships with confidence.

Overview

You’ll design, implement, and maintain automated test suites while executing manual, exploratory, and regression testing. You’ll work across integration tests, end-to-end flows, manual validation, CI/CD pipelines, and release readiness. At this level, you’ll independently run established QA processes, contribute to test automation architecture, and evolve testing practices as we grow.

What Success Looks Like
 * Strong, stable E2E and integration coverage
 * Fewer escaped defects due to automation-first testing
 * Reliable Cypress suites running cleanly in CI/CD
 * Clear reporting on coverage, flakiness, and release risk
 * Predictable, confident releases backed by quality gates

Key ResponsibilitiesAutomation and Engineering Quality
 * Build and maintain automated test suites using Cypress
 * Write and maintain BDD scenarios with Cucumber (Gherkin)
 * Create automated E2E flows for core user journeys
 * Implement integration tests for APIs and service interactions
 * Follow strong engineering practices (clean code, modularity, page/object models)
 * Maintain test data, environments, and automation stability
 * Contribute to automation frameworks and shared QA utilities

CI/CD and Quality Gates
 * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD
 * Enforce quality gates and prevent risky releases
 * Improve test speed, reliability, and determinism
 * Partner with DevOps on pipeline and environment optimization

Reporting and Observability
 * Produce automated test reports and dashboards
 * Surface insights on coverage, flake rate, failure patterns, and release risk
 * Drive prioritization and improvements using quality data

Manual Testing
 * Create and execute manual test cases for new features
 * Perform regression, smoke, and exploratory testing
 * Validate edge cases and complex scenarios not suited for automation
 * Execute pre-release validation and verify defect fixes

Collaboration and Quality Culture
 * Work with engineering and product to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria
 * Participate in sprint ceremonies, test planning, and estimation
 * Influence testing standards and help strengthen a quality-first culture

Qualifications
 * 5+ years in QA or software testing
 * Strong manual testing and test case design skills
 * Hands-on experience with automation frameworks
 * Practical experience with Cypress
 * Familiarity with BDD and Gherkin
 * Ability to turn requirements into test scenarios
 * Comfortable in Agile environments

Preferred Skills
 * Cypress + Cucumber in production
 * API and integration testing
 * Experience building or extending E2E frameworks
 * CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.)
 * Test reporting tools and dashboards
 * JavaScript/TypeScript familiarity
 * Understanding of the test pyramid
 * Experience with quality gates and release automation

Key Metrics for Impact
 * Defect escape rate
 * E2E and integration coverage
 * Automation coverage growth
 * Flake rate and test stability
 * CI/CD execution reliability
 * Manual + automated coverage balance
 * Release readiness accuracy
 * Defect turnaround time

 

BenefitsThe Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

 * Competitive Salary
 * Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance 
 * Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA) 
 * 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
 * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
 * Company-provided technology package 
 * Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
We live in a world where technology is rapidly changing the educational experiences of students and teachers everywhere, and we have the opportunity to shape how this change takes place. Kira's mission is to harness transformative AI technologies to make world-class personalized teaching and learning accessible to everyone. Kira is a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier Venture Capital funds including New Enterprise Associates (NEA), Andrew Ng’s AI Fund, and Primavera.

Quality is critical to ensuring teachers and students can rely on our product every day. As a Manual QA Engineer, you will help ensure a high-quality, reliable experience across our platform. This role is focused on hands-on manual testing, exploratory testing, and validating new features before they reach production. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to deeply understand new features, identify potential issues early, and advocate for the end-user experience. You will play a key role in verifying functionality across complex workflows, including AI-powered features where outputs may be non-deterministic.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, curious about how products work, and passionate about delivering high-quality user experiences.

What You’ll Do


 * Perform manual testing of new product features across web applications and AI-driven workflows
 * Execute regression, exploratory, and acceptance testing to validate new functionality before release
 * Run sanity checks on staging and release builds to ensure stability prior to deployment
 * Write clear, detailed, and reproducible bug reports, including steps to reproduce, logs, and impact assessments
 * Collaborate closely with engineers to debug issues and verify fixes
 * Develop a deep understanding of the product to identify edge cases, usability issues, and quality risks
 * Validate complex teacher and student workflows, including AI-generated outputs and interactive experiences
 * Evaluate features not only for correctness but also usability, clarity, and user experience
 * Help prioritize testing efforts based on product impact and risk
 * Contribute to QA documentation, testing checklists, and release validation processes
 * Participate in release readiness and post-release validation to ensure product stability
   
   

What We’re Looking For


 * 2+ years of experience in manual software testing or quality assurance
 * Experience and expertise in QA processes and UI/UX testing (web and mobile)
 * Strong experience performing manual regression, exploratory, and functional testing
 * Experience testing web applications and user-facing products
 * Ability to write clear and actionable bug reports
 * Strong debugging skills and ability to work closely with engineers to reproduce issues
 * High attention to detail and strong product intuition
 * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and design
 * Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment
 * Strong curiosity and willingness to deeply understand product behavior and edge cases
   
   

Nice to Have


 * Experience testing AI or LLM-powered products
 * Experience testing complex workflows involving APIs, backend systems, or data pipelines
 * Familiarity with basic developer tools (browser dev tools, logs, network inspection)
 * Experience testing distributed systems or modern web stacks
   
   

Our services currently span:


 * Next.js + React frontend
 * Kotlin + Java Spring Boot backend
 * Python FastAPI AI services
 * Langsmith agent workflows
   
   

What Success Looks Like


 * Critical user flows consistently work for teachers and students
 * Bugs are caught early during development rather than after release
 * Engineers have clear, actionable bug reports that speed up debugging
 * Product releases ship with high confidence and minimal regressions
 * AI-driven features behave reliably and degrade gracefully when issues occur
   
   

What we offer


 * Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $90,000 - $120,000 depending on relevant experience and skill set
 * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums
 * Flexible PTO policy and company holidays
 * DoorDash credit for lunch daily
 * Dog friendly office 🐶
   
   

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Kira believes that diversity and inclusion among our employees are critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Selection for employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Background Check

Kira will make a conditional job offer in line with local, state and federal laws, and a subsequent criminal, education, and employment history background check will then be issued.

Quality Assurance Engineer II (Banking) | Acorns

Acorns is seeking a highly skilled and relentlessly customer-focused Quality Assurance Engineer II to be a QA champion for our core Banking offerings.

This role will ensure that Acorns Banking products—including high-interest checking, high-interest emergency savings, check deposit, and paycheck deposit—are accurate, transparent, and instill trust and confidence with our customer base. You’ll be embedded within the Banking Engineering team, reporting to the Quality Assurance Manager, and joining the broader Quality Assurance Engineering team.

Acorns is a remote-first organization, offering the flexibility to work remotely while providing optional access to office space in Irvine, CA.

What You Will Do At Acorns

You will own the quality strategy and execution for our critical financial services, driving automated testing and continuous improvement within a Scrum-based Agile environment.


 * Own the Quality Strategy: You will maintain existing test cases in the automation suite to ensure they are stable, available, and consistently run in alignment with organizational metrics.
 * Drive Automation: Work to meet the goal of increasing strategic automation coverage to 50% across all test types (unit, snapshot, integration, e2e) within your first six months, highly encouraged to use agentic and generative AI technology to achieve efficiency and scale.
 * AI-First Acceleration: Proactively explore, prototype, and implement AI and automation tools (e.g., test case generation, anomaly detection) to maximize testing efficiency, quality, and velocity.
 * Share Knowledge: Document and evangelize AI/ML-driven wins and best practices across the entire QA team and wider Engineering organization to accelerate overall productivity and maintain our AI-first culture.
 * Reduce Risk: Confidently identify problems and propose solutions, taking on projects that identify and mitigate risk while measuring software quality. Your success will be measured, in part, by an improvement in escape rate / reducing incidents.
 * Technical Delivery: Design and deliver test plans for a significant component, set of features, or service within the Banking domain. This includes creating and executing test plans for complex test scenarios.
 * Integrate CI/CD: You will contribute to the team's goal of fully adopting Acorns' Continuous Delivery (CD) strategy in the next six months.
 * Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner heavily with Product Marketing and Data Analytics/Engineering teams to ensure comprehensive product testing and data integrity.
 * Mentorship: After six months, you will be expected to formally mentor a QAE through an internal process or present banking domain knowledge to the wider QA team.
 * Lead Emerging Tech: Collaborate on developing and assuring emerging technology in the banking space, helping to solve complex technical challenges for the team.
   
   

What You Will Bring To Acorns


 * You are relentless in protecting our customers, curious, and ready to contribute to the new vision for Banking.
 * 4–6+ years of software testing experience.
 * 2+ years of dedicated experience in the Banking or Fintech domain.
 * Proficiency in backend/API testing as a primary focus, utilizing TypeScript and GraphQL.
 * Proficiency in Mobile testing (secondary focus), utilizing Kotlin/Espresso and Swift/XCUI.
 * Automated testing experience across various types (unit, integration, e2e).
 * Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: Harness, Spinnaker, GitHub Actions, or buildkite.
 * Have worked in a Scrum-based Agile Development Model.
 * Proficiency partnering with Engineering and Product teams.
 * Hunger to deliver game-changing products

 * A belief that your work is tied to your life's mission

Nice To Have

 * Experience with PNPM, TestRails, Docker/containerization, or Crypto/blockchain.
   
   

You are not expected to have experience with all listed requirements. If you feel passionate about Acorns' mission, vision, and values, please apply.

Acorns is a financial wellness app that helps everyday people and families save and invest money for the long term. title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer / Supplier Quality Engineer

📍 Onsite: Grand Prairie, TX | Contract Manufacturing




About the Company

This well-established manufacturer specializes in the production of precision components for wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and electrical control panels for OEMs. With more than 30 years of experience, the company has built a strong reputation for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction across a wide range of industries.

Their capabilities support sectors such as Critical Power, Industrial Automation, Oil & Gas, Medical, HVAC, Food & Beverage, Aviation, and Defense. Through a commitment to operational excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement, the organization has positioned itself as a trusted manufacturing partner and industry leader.




The Opportunity

We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer or Supplier Quality Engineer to join the Quality team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that both internal quality processes and external suppliers consistently meet the company’s strict quality standards, safety requirements, and regulatory expectations.

While the position has a strong supplier quality focus, it also supports broader quality assurance initiatives including supplier audits, receiving inspection oversight, supplier corrective actions, and root cause analysis.

A key aspect of this role is the ability to independently perform supplier audits and drive corrective actions with suppliers. The ideal candidate will be comfortable identifying process gaps, conducting structured root cause investigations, and ensuring suppliers implement effective corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.

The Quality Assurance Engineer or Supplier Quality Engineer will work cross-functionally with Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to improve supplier performance and support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance overall product quality and customer satisfaction.

This role reports directly to the VP of Quality and supports the broader Quality Department.




Key Responsibilities

Supplier Auditing & Evaluation

 * Conduct supplier audits, assessments, and qualifications for new and existing suppliers
 * Perform detailed evaluations of supplier quality systems, manufacturing processes, and compliance standards
 * Prepare audit reports and communicate findings with internal teams and supplier partners
 * Identify gaps in supplier processes and drive corrective actions to ensure compliance with quality standards
 * Ensure suppliers consistently meet regulatory and company quality expectations




Supplier Quality & Performance Management

 * Monitor supplier performance metrics and track key quality KPIs
 * Analyze supplier data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement
 * Proactively address supplier quality issues before they impact production
 * Work closely with suppliers to improve manufacturing processes and quality controls




Receiving Inspection & Incoming Quality

Receiving inspection is a critical function of this role.

 * Work closely with operations and quality teams to ensure effective receiving inspection processes are implemented and maintained
 * Review incoming material inspection results and verify supplier components meet required specifications
 * Investigate incoming material issues and coordinate resolution with suppliers and internal teams
 * Ensure incoming inspection findings are documented and incorporated into supplier performance evaluations




Corrective Actions & Root Cause Analysis

A major responsibility of this role is driving supplier corrective actions and root cause investigations.

 * Manage Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCAR) and ensure timely resolution of supplier non-conformances
 * Lead structured root cause investigations using methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, and FMEA
 * Work directly with suppliers to develop corrective and preventive actions that eliminate recurring defects
 * Verify effectiveness of corrective actions and ensure issues do not reoccur
 * Escalate unresolved supplier quality issues when necessary




Quality Systems & Process Development

 * Develop and maintain supplier quality plans, inspection procedures, and quality documentation
 * Ensure compliance with industry standards such as ISO 9001, AS9100, AS9102, or ISO 13485
 * Support documentation control and quality system compliance
 * Identify opportunities to strengthen supplier quality processes and systems
 * Assist in developing or improving quality procedures that enhance supplier performance




Cross-Functional Collaboration

 * Partner with Purchasing, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to resolve supplier quality issues
 * Support supplier readiness for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs
 * Collaborate with operations teams to identify quality improvement opportunities
 * Assist in developing quality-related training materials for internal teams




Continuous Improvement

 * Analyze quality metrics, supplier data, and defect trends to identify improvement opportunities
 * Drive initiatives that improve supplier performance, product quality, and operational efficiency
 * Support the organization’s commitment to continuous improvement and customer satisfaction

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
Summary

Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just build products — we craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. In this role, you will be working closely with framework engineering teams and cross functional QA teams, you'll develop automated testing infrastructure, validate new features, and ensure seamless integration across Apple's ecosystem of platforms.

Description

As a Software QA Engineer, you will be responsible for both manual and automated testing across mobile and backend features. You will design, develop and maintain automated test suites using Swift (XCTest/XCUITest) and Python, while also performing manual testing to uncover usability issues, edge cases and regressions that automation may miss. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to understand feature requirements, define test strategies and ensure high-quality releases. Your work will include crafting, implementing and maintaining test plans and test cases, triaging issues and validating fixes in a timely manner. As a representative of the QA team in cross functional discussions, you’ll communicate test results, advocate for quality and help drive process improvements. Additionally, you’ll contribute to our CI/CD infrastructure, improve automation reliability and continuously refine the balance between manual validation and automated coverage to enhance efficiency and product quality.

Minimum Qualifications


 * 1+ years of experience in software testing with strong focus on test automation
 * Experience in Swift/XCTest/XCUITest
 * Experience developing software tests in Python for test automation, tooling or machine learning
 * Proficiency in manual/UI testing and willingness to engage in both
 * Experience developing test plans, test cases, assessing risk, and filing appropriate defects
 * BS in Computer Science or equivalent
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Deep Knowledge of developer tools, SDKs, or framework testing and validation methodologies
 * Proficiency in testing mobile/desktop apps, cloud based frameworks, and backend/APIs
 * Understanding of the software development lifecycle, SQA methodologies, and passion for quality processes
 * Familiarity with continuous integration systems and build automation
 * Ability to thrive in a collaborative working environment within your team and beyond
 * Ability to triage problems, prioritize accordingly, and propose a resolution
 * Familiarity with server architecture
 * Outstanding communication skills for collaborating across many participating teams

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $147,400 and $220,900, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition.
